import sys, os, time, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from reportlab.pdfbase.pdfmetrics import stringWidth
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('e5dc8ef0')
SRC = dict(r28=live, r29=open(_p.__file__).read())
assert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r29'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('q3n_' + n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = {n: mk(n) for n in SRC}
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http')); calls = Counter()
W = lambda s: stringWidth(s, 'Helvetica', 10)

def name_rows(v, who, x, y, end):
    """Rows printed with a block whose By: rule is at (x, y)..end."""
    nm = who
    if v == 'std': return [(y + 12, f'Name: {nm}', False, x), (y + 24, 'Title: CEO', False, x)]
    if v == 'bare': return [(y + 12, nm, False, x), (y + 24, 'Chief Executive Officer', False, x)]
    if v.startswith('dx'):
        d = int(v[2:]); return [(y + 12, f'Name: {nm}', False, x + d), (y + 24, 'Title: CEO', False, x + d)]
    if v.startswith('bdx'):
        d = int(v[3:]); return [(y + 12, nm, False, x + d)]
    if v.startswith('dy'):
        d = int(v[2:]); return [(y + d, f'Name: {nm}', False, x)]
    if v == 'above_bare': return [(y - 14, nm, False, x)]
    if v == 'above_name': return [(y - 14, f'Name: {nm}', False, x)]
    if v == 'above_two': return [(y - 26, nm, False, x), (y - 14, 'Chief Executive Officer', False, x)]
    if v == 'wrap1': return [(y + 12, 'Name:', False, x), (y + 24, nm, False, x)]
    if v == 'wrap2':
        a, b = nm.split(' ', 1); return [(y + 12, f'Name: {a}', False, x), (y + 24, b, False, x)]
    if v == 'wrap3': return [(y + 12, f'Name: {nm},', False, x), (y + 24, 'Chief Executive Officer', False, x)]
    if v == 'ralign': return [(y + 12, f'Name: {nm}', False, end - W(f'Name: {nm}')), (y + 24, 'Title: CEO', False, end - W('Title: CEO'))]
    if v == 'ralign_bare': return [(y + 12, nm, False, end - W(nm))]
    if v == 'center': return [(y + 12, nm, False, (x + end - W(nm)) / 2)]
    if v == 'none': return []
    raise KeyError(v)

VARIANTS = ['std', 'bare', 'dx-30', 'dx-15', 'dx15', 'dx60', 'bdx-30', 'bdx-50', 'bdx40', 'dy6', 'dy18', 'dy30',
            'above_bare', 'above_name', 'above_two', 'wrap1', 'wrap2', 'wrap3', 'ralign', 'ralign_bare', 'center', 'none']

def block(head, company, x, y, v, who, datefirst):
    end = x + 180
    rows = [(y - 50, head, False, x), (y - 38, company, False, x), (y, 'By:', True, x, end)]
    if datefirst is None:
        rows += name_rows(v, who, x, y, end) + [(y + 60, 'Date:', True, x, end)]
    else:
        rows += [(y + 30, 'Date:', True, x, end)] + [(r[0] + 30 + datefirst - 12, *r[1:]) for r in name_rows(v, who, x, y, end) if r[0] > y]
    return rows

G = Counter(); EX = Counter(); t = time.time()
part = sys.argv[1]
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for layout, v, fleetname, datefirst, recital, signer in product(
            ('side', 'stacked'), VARIANTS, ('dan', 'none', 'same_variant'), (None, 12, 20, 30) if part == 'date' else (None,),
            ('parsed', 'none'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both')):
        if datefirst is not None and v.startswith('above'): continue
        fx, fy, hx, hy = (40, 300, 320, 300) if layout == 'side' else (72, 200, 72, 450)
        fv = dict(dan='std', none='none', same_variant=v)[fleetname]
        rows = (block('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', fx, fy, fv, 'Dan Whaley', datefirst)
                + block('RECIPIENT:', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', hx, hy, v, 'Pat Smith', datefirst))
        pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
        people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
        allowed = {rc.PE: (2, hx, hy, hx + 180), rc.DE: (2, fx, fy, fx + 180)}
        pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS[recital]), rows]); k = ''
        for n, m in M.items():
            mo = Mock(); r = in_process(m, pdf, people, mo); calls[n] += mo.call_count
            k += 'W' if rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed) else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
        G[(layout, k)] += 1
        if k[0] != k[1] or 'W' in k: EX[(k, layout, v, fleetname, datefirst, signer)] += 1
print(part, 'http', http.call_count, 'model', dict(calls), 'elapsed', round(time.time() - t), 'cells', sum(G.values()))
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
for key in [lambda k: (k[0], k[1], k[2]), lambda k: (k[0], k[3]), lambda k: (k[0], k[4]), lambda k: (k[0], k[5])]:
    print(sorted(Counter(key(k) for k in EX.elements()).items(), key=str))
